Description: Create table to store Gherkin feature files with fields: id (UUID PK), userId (FK to User), organizationId (FK to Organization), projectId (FK to Project), name (VARCHAR 255), description (TEXT), featureContent (TEXT - raw Gherkin), tags (JSONB), status (ENUM: draft/active/archived), createdAt, updatedAt. Cascade delete on User, SetNull on Project.
Acceptance Criteria: Table created with proper FK constraints, indexes on userId and organizationId

Description: Create child table for scenarios within features: id (UUID PK), featureId (FK to BDDFeature CASCADE), name (VARCHAR 255), scenarioType (ENUM: Scenario/Scenario Outline), description (TEXT), tags (JSONB), examplesData (JSONB - for parameterized Scenario Outlines), sortOrder (INT), createdAt, updatedAt.
Acceptance Criteria: Table created with cascade delete on feature, sortOrder for ordering

Description: Create step table: id (UUID PK), scenarioId (FK to BDDScenario CASCADE), keyword (VARCHAR 10 - Given/When/Then/And/But), text (TEXT - step text), dataTable (JSONB - optional tabular data), docString (TEXT - optional multiline text), stepDefinition (TEXT - Playwright code), sortOrder (INT), createdAt, updatedAt.
Acceptance Criteria: Table created with cascade delete on scenario, supports data tables and doc strings

Description: Create execution tracking table: id (UUID PK), featureId (FK to BDDFeature), scenarioId (FK to BDDScenario optional), userId (FK to User CASCADE), organizationId (FK to Organization), status (ENUM: pending/running/passed/failed/cancelled), duration (INT ms), totalSteps/passedSteps/failedSteps/skippedSteps (INT), errorMsg (TEXT), browser (VARCHAR), executionMode (VARCHAR), reportUrl (VARCHAR), startedAt, completedAt, createdAt, updatedAt.
Acceptance Criteria: Table tracks full execution lifecycle with step counts and error details

Description: Create reusable step definitions table: id (UUID PK), userId (FK to User), organizationId (FK to Organization), pattern (VARCHAR 500 - regex pattern), code (TEXT - Playwright implementation), keyword (VARCHAR 10), description (TEXT), tags (JSONB), usageCount (INT default 0), createdAt, updatedAt.
Acceptance Criteria: Step library entries are org-scoped and track usage count

Description: Create scheduled execution table: id (UUID PK), featureId (FK to BDDFeature), userId (FK to User), organizationId (FK to Organization), cronExpression (VARCHAR 100), tags (VARCHAR), browser (VARCHAR), executionMode (VARCHAR), enabled (BOOLEAN default true), lastRunAt (TIMESTAMP), nextRunAt (TIMESTAMP), createdAt, updatedAt.
Acceptance Criteria: Supports cron expressions with enable/disable toggle

Description: Add columns to BDDRun: screenshotUrls (JSONB array), tags (VARCHAR), parallelWorkers (INT). These support screenshot capture on failure, tag-based filtering, and parallel execution configuration.
Acceptance Criteria: BDDRun table extended with screenshot and parallel execution support

Description: Create tables for Screenplay Pattern: ScreenplayTask (id, userId, organizationId, name, description, code, tags), ScreenplayAction (id, taskId FK, actionType ENUM, target, value, code, sortOrder), ScreenplayQuestion (id, taskId FK, questionType ENUM, target, expectedValue, code, sortOrder).
Acceptance Criteria: Screenplay tables support composable task/action/question pattern

Description: Execute prisma migrate dev to apply all BDD-related schema changes. Verify all tables created with proper constraints, indexes, and relationships.
Acceptance Criteria: All migrations applied successfully, prisma client regenerated

Description: Create parseFeatureContent() function that parses raw Gherkin text and extracts: feature name, description, tags, scenarios (with type detection for Scenario/Scenario Outline), steps (Given/When/Then/And/But with text), data tables, doc strings, and examples data for outlines.
Acceptance Criteria: Parser correctly handles Feature/Scenario/Scenario Outline/Background keywords, tags (@tag), data tables (| col |), doc strings (triple quotes), and Examples sections

Description: Create generatePlaywrightCode() function that converts parsed BDD features into executable Playwright test scripts. Map Given/When/Then steps to Playwright actions (navigation, clicks, fills, assertions). Support data-driven tests from Scenario Outlines.
Acceptance Criteria: Generated code is valid Playwright syntax, handles common step patterns, supports parameterized tests

Description: Create executeFeature() function that: writes feature file to temp directory, injects step definitions (user-defined + step library), runs Playwright/Cucumber via child process, parses output for step results, captures screenshots on failure, stores results in database, generates Serenity report.
Acceptance Criteria: Feature executes end-to-end, results stored, screenshots captured, report generated

Description: Add concurrency management with MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS (default 3) and MAX_QUEUED_RUNS (default 20). Track running processes in Map for cancellation support. Return queue status when limits reached.
Acceptance Criteria: Max 3 concurrent runs enforced, excess requests queued or rejected, status endpoint returns current counts

Description: Support parallel execution with configurable worker count. Split scenarios across workers for faster execution. Track parallel worker count in BDDRun record.
Acceptance Criteria: Parallel execution distributes scenarios across workers, results aggregated correctly

Description: Create EventEmitter-based SSE (Server-Sent Events) system for real-time test execution feedback. Emit events for: run started, step passed/failed/skipped, run completed, error occurred. Support per-run event streams.
Acceptance Criteria: SSE endpoint streams real-time events, frontend receives live updates, connection cleanup on disconnect

Description: Support cancelling running executions by killing the child process. Remove from active runs map. Update run status to 'cancelled' in database.
Acceptance Criteria: Running process killed, status updated to cancelled, resources cleaned up

Description: Create full CRUD operations for reusable step definitions. Steps scoped to user/organization. Track usage count. Support keyword filtering (Given/When/Then). Allow pattern-based matching with regex.
Acceptance Criteria: Step library entries created/read/updated/deleted, org-scoped, usage counted

Description: Create cron-based scheduled BDD execution. Support cronExpression, feature association, browser/mode selection, enable/disable toggle. Track lastRunAt and nextRunAt timestamps.
Acceptance Criteria: Schedules created with cron expressions, can be enabled/disabled, manual trigger supported

Description: Create ScreenplayService with: Task CRUD (compose from actions/questions), Action CRUD (interaction/navigation/input/wait/custom types), Question CRUD (visibility/text/url/title/attribute/count types). Auto-generate Playwright code from compositions. Generate step definitions for Cucumber injection.
Acceptance Criteria: Tasks composed from actions/questions, code auto-generated, step definitions injectable into feature runs

Description: Provide built-in preset actions: Navigate to URL, Click by role/text, Fill by label/placeholder, Select dropdown, Press key, Upload file, Hover element, Check checkbox. Each generates correct Playwright code.
Acceptance Criteria: All preset actions generate valid Playwright code, selectable from UI

Description: Provide built-in preset questions: Element visible/hidden, Page title matches, URL contains, Page contains text, Element has text, Element count, Element has attribute. Each generates correct Playwright assertion code.
Acceptance Criteria: All preset questions generate valid Playwright assertions, selectable from UI

Description: Create SerenityReportService that generates beautiful HTML reports with: header with feature/status, narrative section (As a/I want to/So that), summary donut chart, stat cards, execution timeline, scenario details with collapsible cards, step-by-step results with errors and screenshots, feature file syntax highlighting, embedded CSS, responsive design, print support.
Acceptance Criteria: HTML report generated with all sections, syntax highlighting, responsive layout, print-friendly

Description: Save failure screenshots to playwright-crx-reports/bdd-artifacts/. Store screenshot URLs in BDDRun.screenshotUrls JSONB array. Display in reports and frontend.
Acceptance Criteria: Screenshots captured on step failure, stored in artifacts directory, URLs saved to database

Description: Implement REST controller with methods: createFeature (parse Gherkin + save), getFeatures (list with filters), getFeature (by ID), updateFeature (re-parse + update), deleteFeature. All operations tenant-aware via auth middleware.
Acceptance Criteria: CRUD operations work correctly, auto-parsing on create/update, tenant isolation enforced

Description: Implement execution endpoints: runFeature (with browser/mode/tags/workers options), getRuns (list all), getRun (by ID with step results), cancelRun, deleteRun. Include SSE streaming endpoint.
API Endpoints: POST /api/bdd/features/:id/run; GET /api/bdd/runs; GET /api/bdd/runs/:id; POST /api/bdd/runs/:id/cancel; DELETE /api/bdd/runs/:id; GET /api/bdd/runs/:id/stream
Acceptance Criteria: Execution triggered via API, runs tracked, SSE streaming works, cancellation supported

Description: Implement: parseFeature (parse Gherkin without saving), generateCode (convert feature to Playwright script). Used by frontend for preview and code generation.
Acceptance Criteria: Parsing returns structured feature data, code generation returns valid Playwright script

Description: Implement CRUD endpoints for step library: getStepLibrary (list with org filter), createStepEntry, updateStepEntry, deleteStepEntry.
Acceptance Criteria: Step library CRUD works, org-scoped filtering, usage tracking

Description: Implement schedule endpoints: getSchedules, createSchedule, updateSchedule, deleteSchedule, runSchedule (manual trigger).
Acceptance Criteria: Schedule CRUD works, cron validation, manual trigger executes feature

Description: Register all BDD routes under /api/bdd/ prefix with auth middleware (authMiddleware) and optional tenant middleware (optionalTenantMiddleware). Routes: features CRUD, parse, generate, run, runs management, stream, status, step-library, schedules.
Acceptance Criteria: All routes registered, auth enforced, tenant middleware applied

Description: Import and register BDD routes in main Express app (index.ts). Ensure routes are mounted at /api/bdd prefix.
Acceptance Criteria: BDD routes accessible at /api/bdd/*, authenticated requests work

Description: Set up Express static file serving for BDD reports directory (playwright-crx-reports/) so generated Serenity HTML reports are accessible via HTTP.
Acceptance Criteria: Reports accessible at /playwright-crx-reports/bdd-{runId}/index.html

Description: Ensure all BDD operations respect organization boundaries. Features, runs, step library, and schedules filtered by organizationId. Concurrent execution limits configurable per organization.
Acceptance Criteria: Org isolation enforced, cross-org access prevented, per-org concurrency limits respected

Description: Create main BDDTesting.tsx component with tab-based navigation: Features, Runs, Step Library, Schedules. Manage component state with React useState/useEffect hooks. Handle API calls with Axios.
Acceptance Criteria: Tab navigation works, state management correct, API integration functional

Description: Create two-panel editor: left panel has Gherkin textarea with monospace font and dark theme, right panel shows parsed scenario tree preview. Include form fields for name, description, tags, project selection. Buttons: Create, Update, Delete, Run.

Description: Show feature cards in grid layout with: name, description, scenario count, run count, status badge (draft/active/archived), tags. Click to load feature into editor. Support filtering and sorting.

Description: Apply CSS-based syntax highlighting in editor preview: keywords (Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then) in bold color, strings in quotes highlighted, tags (@tag) in distinct color, comments in grey.
Acceptance Criteria: Keywords, strings, tags visually distinct in preview panel

Description: Display parsed scenarios in tree structure: Feature > Scenario/Scenario Outline > Steps (Given/When/Then/And/But). Show step keyword in bold, step text, data tables, examples data for outlines.
Acceptance Criteria: Scenario tree shows hierarchy, steps display with keywords, data tables rendered

Description: Display list of BDD execution runs as cards with: feature name, status badge (pending/running/passed/failed/cancelled), duration, step counts (passed/failed/skipped), progress bar, error messages, browser type, execution mode. Buttons: View Report, Cancel (if running), Delete.
Acceptance Criteria: Run cards show all execution details, progress bars accurate, action buttons work

Task Name: Implement SSE Live Streaming in UI

Description: Create execution options when clicking Run button: browser selection (chromium/firefox/webkit), execution mode (headless/headed), tag filter, parallel workers count, custom step definitions textarea. Submit triggers feature execution.
Acceptance Criteria: Execution options configurable, run triggered with selected options, redirects to Runs tab

Description: Display step library entries in list with: pattern regex, keyword badge, description, usage count, tags. Create new step form: pattern input, keyword dropdown, code editor (monospace), description, tags. Edit/Delete actions on each entry.
Acceptance Criteria: Step library displays entries, create form works, edit/delete functional, usage count shown

Description: Display scheduled runs with: feature name, cron expression, browser, next run time, last run time, enabled/disabled toggle. Create schedule form: feature dropdown, cron expression input, browser selection, mode selection. Edit/Delete/Toggle/Manual Run actions.
Acceptance Criteria: Schedules display correctly, create/edit forms work, toggle enable/disable, manual run triggers execution

Description: Add 'View Report' button on completed runs that opens Serenity HTML report in new tab. Report URL constructed from run ID. Handle cases where report not yet generated.

Description: Show failure screenshots in run details. Display screenshot thumbnails with click-to-enlarge. Support multiple screenshots per run from screenshotUrls array.

Description: Create comprehensive CSS file with: container layout (max-width 1200px), tab navigation styling, editor dark theme (#1e1e2e), feature/run cards with hover effects, status badges with colors, progress bars, step result styling with keyword colors, buttons (primary/success/danger/secondary), empty states, responsive design.
